prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on your goals, industry, budget and the services you need. I can help you find the best fit; first, a quick way to narrow it down plus next steps.

Quick questions
- What kind of marketing do you need? (digital/SEO/SEM, creative/brand, social, B2B demand gen, healthcare, experiential, etc.)
- What is your monthly or project budget?
- Are you local (need in-person meetings) or is remote okay?
- Do you have a timeline or KPIs ( leads, sales, awareness)?

How to identify the best fit (checklist)
- Relevant experience: case studies and clients in your industry or with similar goals.
- Measurable results: clear KPIs and examples (conversion rates, ROI, traffic increases).
- Services & capabilities: do they cover everything you need (creative, media buying, analytics)?
- Team & communication: who will work on your account and how often will they report?
- Transparency: pricing model, reporting cadence, and tools used.
- Reviews & references: Clutch, UpCity, Google reviews, and direct references.
- Contract terms: length, performance clauses, and exit terms.

Resources to find top Maryland agencies
- Clutch.co and UpCity (filter by location + service)
- Google Maps & Google reviews (search “digital marketing agency near Baltimore”)
- Local business networks and AMA Maryland chapter
- LinkedIn for portfolio and client recommendations

What I can do next
- If you tell me your industry, goals, and budget I’ll shortlist 4–6 Maryland agencies that match and include why each is a fit and questions to ask them.
- Or I can draft an RFP template you can send to agencies to compare proposals.

Which would you prefer?
